title: Frontend Engineer (React)
description: Focuses on React components, lifecycle, hooks, state management, and performance.

questions.text: Describe how you manage global state in a large-scale React application. When would you choose context API vs Redux/Zustand?
How do you optimize the performance of a React application with a very large list of data?
What are React Portals and when would you use them for modal overlays or dialog boxes?
Can you explain the concept of Higher-Order Components (HOC) and how they compare to custom hooks?
What are React Server Components and how do they differ from Server-Side Rendering (SSR)?

title: Frontend Proctored (React)
description: Live video proctored interview assessing advanced React architecture, state management, and performance.

questions.text: What are the main differences between custom hooks and the render props pattern?
Describe your approach to testing React components. What tools do you use?
Explain the concept of compound components in React and give a production example.
How would you handle theme switching dynamically using CSS variables and React Context API?
What are some common security vulnerabilities in React applications and how do you mitigate them?

title: Backend Engineer (Node/Express)
description: Covers event loop, asynchronous design patterns, RESTful design, and security.

questions.text: Explain the difference between clustered environments and worker threads in Node.js.
What is the purpose of the cluster module and how does it scale applications across CPU cores?
What is your approach to handling transactions and concurrent updates in databases like MongoDB or PostgreSQL?
Describe a scenario where you would use Streams in Node.js instead of standard file system buffer methods.
How do you analyze a heap dump to debug memory leaks in a running Node.js process?

title: HR & Behavioral Round
description: General HR behavioral questions assessing cultural fit, conflict resolution, and leadership.

questions.text: Why do you want to join our company, and where do you see your career heading in the next 3 to 5 years?
How do you handle feedback or criticism from a peer code review?
Describe your process for prioritizing tasks when everything seems urgent and high priority.
Describe a time when you received difficult feedback. How did you react and what changes did you make?
Tell me about a time you failed or made a significant mistake. How did you handle the aftermath?

title: System Architect
description: Advanced systems architecture, scaling databases, caching strategy, microservices, and high-availability designs.

questions.text: Describe your approach to database sharding vs replication. When would you use one over the other?
Explain how Consistent Hashing works and why it is useful in distributed caching or database sharding.
How do you design a system for high availability and disaster recovery across multiple regions?
How would you architect a real-time collaborative document editor like Google Docs?
Design a ride-sharing service like Uber. Focus on the dispatcher service and geospatial querying.

title: HR Interview
description: General behavioral and cultural fit questions for any role.

questions.text: How do you manage professional pressure and tight production deadlines?
Where do you see yourself in 5 years?
Tell me about a time you handled a difficult situation with a coworker.
Why are you leaving your current role?
Tell me about a time you had to learn a completely new skill very quickly.

title: Java
description: Technical questions covering core Java, JVM, multithreading, and OOP.

questions.text: What are Lambda expressions in Java 8 and how do they improve code readability?
Explain the concept of multithreading in Java and how to create a thread.
Explain the difference between fail-fast and fail-safe iterators in collections.
What are the main differences between HashMap and ConcurrentHashMap?
Explain the difference between final, finally, and finalize keywords in Java.

title: C Programming
description: Core concepts in C including pointers, memory management, and data structures.

questions.text: Explain the difference between malloc() and calloc().
What is the purpose of the volatile keyword?
Explain the difference between a macro and an inline function.
What is a pointer to a pointer in C?
What is the static keyword used for in C variables and functions?

title: Python
description: Python fundamentals, data structures, decorators, and memory management.

questions.text: What is a list comprehension and a dict comprehension in Python?
Explain list comprehensions with an example.
What is the difference between *args and **kwargs in Python function definitions?
Explain how exception handling works with try-except-finally blocks.
How is memory managed in Python?

title: HTML
description: HTML5 features, semantics, accessibility, and DOM structure.

questions.text: What is the difference between HTML and XHTML?
Explain the difference between block and inline elements.
Explain the purpose of SVG and Canvas in HTML5.
What is semantic HTML and how does it help accessibility?
How do you use meta tags for SEO and responsive display viewport configuration?

title: CSS
description: CSS Box Model, layout models (Flexbox/Grid), animations, and responsive design.

questions.text: Describe approaches to making a website responsive without media queries.
How do you implement CSS animations and transition keyframes?
What are pseudo-classes and pseudo-elements?
What are CSS preprocessors like SASS or LESS, and why are they useful?
How does CSS specificity work?

title: JavaScript
description: Core JS concepts: closures, promises, event loop, and ES6+ features.

questions.text: Explain closures in JavaScript and provide an example of when to use one.
What is prototype-based inheritance in JavaScript?
What is the difference between == and ===?
Explain the difference between call, apply, and bind.
How does the event loop handle asynchronous operations?

title: Web Development
description: General web architecture, REST APIs, HTTP protocols, and security.

questions.text: Explain the difference between HTTP and HTTPS.
What is a RESTful API and what are its core principles?
What is DNS and how does it resolve domain names to IP addresses?
How does client-side caching work using ETag and Cache-Control headers?
Explain how you would optimize a website for better performance.

title: Authentication
description: OAuth, JWTs, session management, and securing web applications.

questions.text: How do you securely store passwords in a database?
Explain multi-factor authentication (MFA) and common implementations.
Explain the difference between OAuth2 and SAML.
Describe the OAuth 2.0 flow.
What is single sign-on (SSO) and how does it work?
